description: Describe one domain of the AHOOK API: returns the compact OpenAPI slice (operations + the schemas they reference) for that domain, so you can discover what the API can do without loading the whole spec. The response also lists every available domain with its operation count. One call = one metered read.

tag.description: The domain to describe, e.g. ledger, groups, newsletter, inboxes. Required.

name: api_describe
